patterns.name: Blazor ServerPrerendered Renderer Conflict
patterns.signature: System.InvalidOperationException: JavaScript interop calls cannot be issued during server-side prerendering
patterns.root_cause: JSInterop called during prerender phase when JavaScript runtime is not available
symptoms: Component renders but JS features fail

solution.description: Change render mode from ServerPrerendered to Server in _Host.cshtml or App.razor
solution.validation: Run application, verify no prerender errors in console

patterns.prevention: Default to RenderMode.Server for components using JavaScript interop

patterns.name: Self-Contained Executable Configuration Embedding
patterns.signature: Configuration file changes not reflected after deployment
patterns.root_cause: Self-contained publish embeds appsettings.json at compile-time, runtime changes ignored
symptoms: Different behavior between Debug and Release

solution.description: Switch from self-contained to framework-dependent deployment OR implement external configuration provider
steps: OR: Implement IConfiguration with external JSON file provider
Rebuild and test configuration changes take effect
solution.validation: Change appsettings.json value, restart app without rebuild, verify change applied

patterns.prevention: Prefer framework-dependent deployment for applications requiring runtime configuration

patterns.name: Dynamic JSON Deserialization Runtime Exception
patterns.signature: Microsoft.CSharp.RuntimeBinder.RuntimeBinderException: 'object' does not contain a definition for '{property}'
patterns.root_cause: ReadFromJsonAsync<dynamic>() lacks compile-time type safety, properties accessed without validation
symptoms: API calls succeed but property access fails
Works in some scenarios, fails in others (data-dependent)

solution.description: Replace dynamic with JsonElement for type-safe parsing
steps: Access properties: if (jsonDoc.TryGetProperty("propertyName", out JsonElement prop))
Validate types before conversion: prop.GetString(), prop.GetInt32(), etc.
solution.validation: Test with missing properties, null values, type mismatches

patterns.prevention: Always use JsonElement or strongly-typed DTOs for JSON deserialization

patterns.name: PowerShell Profile Directory Conflict
patterns.signature: Build commands fail silently, dotnet commands not found or execute in wrong directory
patterns.root_cause: PowerShell profile changes working directory without notification, scripts assume wrong CWD
symptoms: Commands succeed locally but fail in automation

solution.description: Use absolute paths + validate working directory in scripts
steps: Convert relative paths to absolute: $AbsPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'relative\path'
Test script in clean PowerShell session (powershell.exe -NoProfile)
solution.validation: Run scripts with -NoProfile flag, verify no path errors

patterns.prevention: Always use absolute paths in automation scripts, validate CWD at script start

patterns.name: ESLint Unused Variable Accumulation
patterns.signature: ESLint: 'error' is defined but never used (no-unused-vars)
patterns.root_cause: Catch blocks capturing exceptions without using them for logging or handling
symptoms: Code smell indicating missing error handling

solution.description: Use underscore for intentionally unused variables or implement proper error handling
steps: Option 1: Rename to underscore: catch (_error) { /* intentionally unused */ }
Option 2: Add logging: catch (error) { console.error('Operation failed:', error); }
Option 3: Disable rule: catch (error) { /* eslint-disable-line no-unused-vars */ }
solution.validation: Run npm run lint, verify zero no-unused-vars errors

patterns.prevention: Default to logging errors in catch blocks, use underscore prefix for intentionally unused vars

patterns.name: Workspace Cleanup Regression
patterns.signature: Legacy experimental files with syntax errors found in TEMP folders
patterns.root_cause: Temporary experiment files not removed after task completion
symptoms: Old test files interfere with builds

solution.description: Implement completion workflow cleanup step + update .gitignore
steps: Add to task.prompt.md Step 9: List all TEMP files created during execution
Document kept files in key data stream
solution.validation: Run build with clean workspace, verify no syntax errors from abandoned files

patterns.prevention: Always clean up TEMP files during completion workflow, use .gitignore for experiment patterns

patterns.name: File Lock Build Failures
patterns.signature: MSBuild error: The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process
patterns.root_cause: Previous Kestrel process not fully terminated before rebuild attempt
symptoms: More frequent after crashes or debugger stops

solution.description: Implement process cleanup with retry logic before build
steps: Add to build script header: Stop-Process -Name 'NoorCanvas' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Retry logic: for ($i=0; $i -lt 3; $i++) { dotnet build; if ($?) { break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }
solution.validation: Build immediately after crash, verify automatic recovery

patterns.prevention: Always stop running processes before build, implement retry with backoff

patterns.name: Database Timeout Network Issues
patterns.signature: NOOR-ERROR: Database timeout - unable to connect to SQL Server
patterns.root_cause: Network connectivity interruption to SQL Server, no retry logic

solution.description: Implement connection retry policy with exponential backoff
steps: Add to DbContext configuration: optionsBuilder.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3, maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5), null)
Add startup validation: using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope(); var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>(); await db.Database.CanConnectAsync()
Implement circuit breaker for repeated failures
solution.validation: Disconnect network during startup, verify retry attempts, reconnect and verify recovery

patterns.prevention: Always configure retry policies for external dependencies (DB, APIs)
